svg.aria-label: The two cost levers in Atlas. Destroying or scaling the cluster down terminates the worker nodes and stops compute billing. Scaling the applications to zero frees memory but leaves the nodes powered on, so it saves nothing — a cloud bills a node for running, not for how many pods it holds.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: · only one of them saves money

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A cloud bills a worker node for being RUNNING, not for how many pods it holds. That single fact decides which lever is worth pulling.
